Daily Cron Watchdog — monitor all other cron jobs for health.

## Steps:

1. Run: openclaw cron list
   - Parse ALL registered crons
   - For each cron, check: enabled, last run time, status, next run scheduled

2. Run: openclaw cron runs --limit 50
   - Check recent run history for failures
   - Flag any cron that failed in the last 24h

3. For each cron, classify as:
   - ✅ Healthy — ran on schedule, completed OK
   - ⚠️ Warning — last run was >2x its interval ago
   - ❌ Failed — last run failed or disabled
   - 🔄 Stale — registered but no run in >7 days

4. If ANY cron is ❌ Failed:
   - Try to re-enable it if disabled
   - Include details in report: which cron failed, when, and what you did

5. If ANY cron is 🔄 Stale:
   - Flag it — might be orphaned or misconfigured

## Output:
Save report to reports/cron-health-$(date +%Y-%m-%d).md

Format as a table:
| Cron Name | Schedule | Last Run | Status | Next Run | Health |

Include summary: X healthy, X warning, X failed, X stale
